senses.gloss: m. (preced. wds.) hanging, covering, esp. table outfit, linen.—Pl. טֵלִים, constr. טְלֵי.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 68a:1">Keth. 68ᵃ</cite> top, will you dine <he>בט׳ כסף או בט׳ זהב</he> with the silver outfit, i.e. with the outfit used in connection with silver vessels, or with the gold outfit?—

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 78b">B. Mets. 78ᵇ</cite> has the worm come <he>בט׳ כסף או בט׳ זהב</he> in the silver outfit (white linen) &c.?; cmp. <cite ref="A00684"><he>אוֹלָרִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="H00806"><he>חִימּוּצָתָא</he></cite>.
